included: Phase-B per-arm arm_manifest.json raw integrity verification
Phase-B per-arm maintenance descriptor transitive-hash projection
excluded: maintenance.jsonl record projection semantics beyond the separately frozen record-level contract
Phase-B seed-level phase_b_manifest projection or transitive-hash handling

replay_protocol.rule: Phase-B may remove only the four predeclared maintenance-record timing diagnostics and the six frozen timing-only maintenance-summary fields; all other fields remain fail-closed.

direct_timing_dependencies.reason: This is the raw SHA-256 of maintenance.jsonl; the historical JSONL bytes include the four predeclared maintenance-record timing fields.
Historical summarize_symbolic_maintenance computes this as shap_seconds + surrogate_seconds + lifecycle_seconds.

transitive_timing_dependencies.reason: Historical _freeze_arm canonical-hashes the complete arm manifest, including files.maintenance.sha256 and maintenance_summary.
Historical write_json_new adds payload_sha256 over the arm-manifest object after manifest_sha256 has already been inserted.

required_order: Load arm_manifest.json fail-closed as a JSON object with duplicate-key rejection.
Verify payload_sha256 against canonical JSON of the raw arm-manifest object with only payload_sha256 removed; manifest_sha256 remains present.
Verify manifest_sha256 against canonical JSON of the raw arm-manifest object with both payload_sha256 and manifest_sha256 removed.
Require files to be an object and require every descriptor path to remain inside the arm root.
Verify every files.*.sha256 against the referenced raw file bytes, including maintenance.jsonl, initial_state.json, final_state.json, and every versions/*.json descriptor.

Apply the separately frozen maintenance-record projection to accepted and fresh maintenance.jsonl and require ordered record-count-preserving exact projected equality before relaxing files.maintenance.sha256.
raw_integrity_verification_before_projec.rationale_for_raw_maintenance_sha256_ine: The raw maintenance JSONL byte hash is allowed to differ only because its predeclared timing fields may differ; each side must still match its own verified descriptor before projection.

recomputation_rule.projected_arm_manifest_canonical_sha256: Compute as comparison evidence over the projected manifest after the permitted removals.
recomputation_rule.projected_maintenance_sequence_canonical: May be retained as comparison evidence from the separately frozen ordered maintenance-record projection.
recomputation_rule.rule: Do not replace files.maintenance.sha256 with a projected semantic hash; the historical field is a raw byte SHA-256 and is removed only from the projected comparison object after its raw integrity has been verified.

permitted_arm_manifest_projection.equality_rule: Accepted and fresh projected arm manifests must have identical canonical JSON SHA-256 values and exact recursive content equality.

file_descriptor_rules.maintenance_sha256: raw integrity required on each side, then removed only from projected arm-manifest equality after maintenance-record projected equality passes

exact_fields_and_hashes.state_and_version_content_rule: Initial-state, final-state, publication metadata, rule-base canonical/history identities, version descriptor keys/paths, and version-file byte hashes are not timing diagnostics and remain exact.

fail_closed_conditions: missing or extra file descriptor key
descriptor SHA-256 does not match referenced raw bytes
maintenance-record projection fails or projected ordered records differ
any top-level arm-manifest difference outside the explicitly removed derived identities
any additional timing/hash exclusion not listed in this contract
